verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that connects Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents to metrics, logs, traces and alerts in natural language. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists, and the AI use-case docs (deploy investigation, alert tuning, dashboard creation) show what agents can do through it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and evidenced details on setup, auth and the exposed tool set.
